notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate detection offers editing the existing item, but “Save anyway” still permits duplicates.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title and tags, but lack descriptions and real favicons.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and notes, but bookmarks have no searchable description.
REF-BM-14: Search treats #tag as ordinary text and implements no tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase syntax is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no operation to mark a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: No action can target the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to newest-first with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
